summary.headline: Neapolitan Codex Astrological Extracts
summary.text: Catalog entry for Neapolitan codex folios 403–407v, preserving astrological excerpts by Valens, Maschallah, Rhetorius, Maximus, Hephaestion, and Protagoras, followed by chapter lemmas on horoscopes, nativities, illness, buying and selling, journeys, treasures, marriage, lawsuits, and zodiacal signs.
